test_title: PYST 85: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A × B means A is the brother of B, A + B means A is the father of B, A - B means A is the sister of B and A ÷ B means A is the wife of B.

If P × Q ÷ H + D - B + M, then how is Q related to M?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife 
 
 

 

Given: P × Q ÷ H + D - B + M

It means: P is the brother of Q, Q is the wife of H, H is the father of D, D is the sister of B and B is the father of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501b12f9be81aed5c6439e2a1421663fcaa8b9b4c75a00816eb1dbeb75af3aaa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952939b9e0922208593f5b760911a1f2b407d540dc1226864edf2c8213d4b470.png] 

So, Q is the '**Father's mother'** of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father's mother'.
